plot: On Statue Day morning grumpy tow truck Grumpy can't stop giggling and must lift the Golden Wheel statue by noon; Doctor Dottie finds his engine fine, the Truth Press shows he is honestly grumpy inside, and the giggles make the statue roll away, until Pip notices he only giggles when he moves and Bertha's talk of her ticklish pom-pom leads Dottie to find it stuck in his tow hook since he pulled Bertha from the mud; Pip pops it out, the statue goes up at noon; lesson: when a friend acts strange, ask how to help; then Bolt's hat starts to giggle.

script.title: Why Is Grumpy Giggling?! 🤭🚚 Wheelburg Mystery
script.description: Grumpy never giggles... until today! Inspector Bolt and Doctor Dottie must find out why before the Golden Wheel goes up at noon. When a friend acts strange, ask how to help. Inspector Bolt #12

beats.say: Hee-hee! Ha-ha! Hoo! Somebody please stop my giggles!
Why is Grumpy giggling? Grumpy never giggles!
It was Statue Day morning in Wheelburg. And Grumpy was giggling.
I am not giggling. Hee-hee! Okay, I am. Hmph!
Oh my! Grumpy, you sound like a happy kettle!
Is he happy? He doesn't look happy. He looks worried.
At noon I must lift the Golden Wheel statue. Hee!
The Golden Wheel had to be up on the podium by noon.
And I can't help today. I lost my pom-pom!
Your pink fluffy pom-pom that hangs on your mirror?
Yes! It fell off when Grumpy pulled me out of the mud.
Mud. Pulling. Then giggles. What a terrible morning. Hee-hee!
Forget the pom-pom! Grumpy has turned NICE! Call a doctor!
So they called the best repair van in town.
Doctor Dottie is here! Who has a funny noise?
Me. My noise goes hee-hee. Fix it, please.
Open your hood, please. And say vroom.
Vroom. Hee-hee-hee! Vroom!
Engine, perfect. Wheels, perfect. Lights, perfect. Giggles? A mystery!

beats.text: WHERE DO THE GIGGLES COME FROM?

beats.say: Then a blue car with a brown hat rolled into the square.
Good morning. I heard a very rare sound. A grumpy giggle.
Inspector! Grumpy has turned nice! It's an emergency!
Being nice is never an emergency, Turbo. But this is odd.
Procedure. First, we find out if the giggles are real.
Grumpy rolled under the Truth Press.
Grumpy, tell the truth. Are you happy inside today?
No. I'm grumpy inside. Very grumpy. Hee-hee-hee!
The press squeezed. His eyes stayed small. It was the truth!
Grumpy inside, but giggly outside? That's the weirdest thing ever!
Poor sweetie! Giggles that aren't even happy giggles!
Then it's not a feeling. Something is making him giggle!
Maybe a giggle bug flew into his engine!
No bugs, Turbo. I checked. Not even a tiny one.
And noon is coming. We have one hour to lift that statue.
Let me try now. Giggles or no giggles. Hee!
Grumpy backed up to the Golden Wheel and lowered his hook.
Hee-hee-HOO-HA-HA! I can't hold it! Hee!
The Golden Wheel wobbled, bounced, and started to roll!
I got it! I got it! I... don't got it!
Turbo zoomed around the square three times before he caught it.
Caught it! And I only bumped into Bertha twice.
Three times, Turbo! Now my roof is flat as a pancake!
Wait! Grumpy didn't giggle once while Turbo was zooming!
Excellent noticing, Pip. While we chased, Grumpy stood still.
Grumpy. Please turn to your left. Very slowly.
Hee-hee-hee! Hoo!
Now stop. Do not move one single wheel.
I'm stopped. No giggles. Hmph. That's much better.
So he only giggles when he moves! But why?
Everyone thought very hard. Thinking makes cars very quiet.
When did the giggles start, Grumpy? Think back!
After the mud. Before breakfast. Hee. Right in between.
Maybe moving is just super funny! Watch! Ha. Nope. Not funny.
My pom-pom always tickles me when I drive over bumps.
Tickles. Bertha, say that once more, please.
My fluffy pom-pom tickles! That's why I hang it up high!
Bong! went the town clock. Only ten minutes until noon!
Grumpy, where does it feel giggly? Your hood? Your wheels?
My tow hook. It has felt fluffy since the mud.
Hold very still! Let me look inside that hook!
Doctor Dottie peeked inside. Then she gasped.
Something pink is stuck in there! Soft and fluffy and pink!
My pom-pom! It got stuck in your hook in the mud!
So Grumpy isn't nice. He's TICKLISH! That's even better!
Tell no one. Hee. Wait. Everyone heard. Hmph.
Pip, your little wheels fit where no one else can reach.
I'll pull it out! Hold on, Grumpy! One, two, three!
Hee-hee-HAA! Hurry, Pip! Hurry! Hee-hee!
Pip tugged. Grumpy giggled. And then... pop!
My pom-pom! Thank you, Pip! Thank you, Doctor Dottie!
No more giggles. Now hand me that wheel.
One strong pull, and the Golden Wheel was up. Right at noon!
A perfect lift! I'll write that in my doctor book!
And my pom-pom goes back on my mirror, high and safe!
Grumpy, can I tickle you, just one time?
No. Maybe on my birthday. Hmph.
Hmph. Too shiny. I still don't like shiny things.
Today's lesson. When a friend acts strange, ask how to help.
And never tickle a tow truck. Unless he says yes!
Then Bolt's hat began to giggle. Who was hiding under it?
